items.summary: Recommendation: continue only the six existing bounded, reversible workstreams below. Attribution is incomplete and direct costs are unavailable, so reject site-level revenue, ROI, margin, CAC, payback, profitability, and forecast claims; keep SearchWoot private and authorize no new production, security-sensitive, spending, or high-priority queue work. Measure each change after 14 days or 100 new impressions. Owner decision: keep the private launch gate unchanged?
